[SWS_DM_00933]
UDS DTC status bit
5 / ’testFailedSinceLastClear’ after dis-
placement
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04067, RS_Diag_04118
⌈
If an event memory entry was removed during displacement AND the configu-
ration parameter
DiagnosticMemoryDestination.statusBitHandlingTest-
FailedSinceLastClear
is set to
statusBitAgingAndDisplacement
AND
Di-
agnosticCommonProps.resetConfirmedBitOnOverflow
is set to "
true
", the
DM shall reset the
UDS DTC status bit
5 / ’testFailedSinceLastClear’ to ’0’.
⌋
